say:0:1720921501:1.text: Before Maska can recover from the backlash, the maid shoulders past him and hurries off, muttering angrily to herself.
say:0:1720921501:1.source_cn: 年轻女仆用力地推开呆若木鸡的马斯卡，快步离去，嘴里还不...

say:2:1720921502:1.text: ... So that didn't really work either.
say:2:1720921502:1.source_cn: 老师……看来，你这招……好像也不太管用啊。

say:3:1720921503:1.text: She could've said no like a normal person... What a temper!

say:5:1720921504:1.text: That's reporting for you. Nine closed doors for every one that opens...
